response.final_text:
**Proposed disposition:** CLOSE_FP, confidence 0.75. A human analyst still has to decide.

**Facts that drove it:**
1. The BUY of 18,050 (6.99x depth) sat 1 tick behind the touch and was cancelled after 1.53s. There was no opposite-side execution, no price move and no reversion, so there was no benefit (feature b).
2. A corrected BUY of 1,805, exactly one tenth of the size, went in at the touch 0.4s after the cancel and was partly filled (157). That points to a size entry error.
3. There were no repeats in the session, no prior alerts on this trader, no market events and no risk events. The trader is not a registered market maker.

**What would change my mind:** Any SELL execution by this trader near the window, or a repeat of large one-sided orders in the session. A longer frame showing that this trader normally trades 18k clips would also weaken the entry-error reading.
